State_change_caption: The sequence of images captures the initial stages of mixing dry ingredients. Initially, the flour is undisturbed and the brown ingredient is distinct. As the mixing commences by hand, the ingredients start to intermingle, creating a marbled effect. Progressing to using a wooden spoon, the mixture becomes more homogenized, losing the distinctness of the separate components. The texture evolves from a fine powder to a more aggregated mixture, indicating the gradual process of creating a uniform dry mix before any wet ingredients are added.
